newsitem.title: HONG KONG: Asia/Pac 97 printer market seen near 5.6 mln units.
newsitem.headline: Asia/Pac 97 printer market seen near 5.6 mln units.

text.p: Demand for computer printers in the major Asia/Pacific markets was expected to approach 5.6 million units in 1997, up 14 percent from last year, market research firm Dataquest said on Monday.

Dataquest said printer shipments in the 10 major Asia/Pacific markets outside Japan exceeded 4.9 million units worth over US$2.9 billion in 1996, up 32 percent in volume and 13 percent in end-user revenue over the previous year.
South Korea accounted for 27 percent of end-user revenues, followed by China, Australia and Taiwan. The four largest markets together accounted for 71 percent of regional revenues.
Hewlett-Packard Co was the region's leading vendor in 1996, followed by Seiko-Epson Corp and Canon Inc, Dataquest said.
